regulatory_descriptor: A Unit-Linked, Non-Participating, Individual Pension Plan
key_benefits: Vesting Benefit: on survival to vesting, Fund Value on the vesting date is payable (used to buy annuity or partly commuted)
Options at vesting: utilise the Vesting Benefit to buy immediate/deferred annuity, or commute/withdraw up to 60% and annuitise the balance
Death Benefit (Classic): higher of Fund Value or Guaranteed Death Benefit paid to nominee
Death Benefit (Assure): Guaranteed Death Benefit paid as lump sum immediately on death AND future premiums funded by the Company, with Fund Value paid to nominee at end of term (Waiver of Premium)
Guaranteed Death Benefit = 105% of Total Premiums Paid including top-up premiums
Return of Allocation Charges, Loyalty Addition and Vesting Booster added to the fund
Market-linked growth across a wide range of funds with unlimited free fund switches
Liquidity: partial withdrawal allowed on major life event or critical illness

eligibility.premium_payment_term: Single / Limited / Regular premium payment (Product Eligibility section present but numeric ranges not recovered from parse)
eligibility.note: Product Eligibility table is present in the brochure but the numeric entry/vesting-age, policy-term and premium ranges were not recovered from this structural parse. For QROPS purchases (UK tax-relieved asset transfer), minimum entry age for annuity payment is restricted to age 55 or vesting age.

key_terms.free_look_note: 30 days from the date of receipt of the policy document. For QROPS purchases, free-look cancellation proceeds are only transferred back per the applicable rules.
key_terms.grace_period: 30 days for yearly, half-yearly and quarterly premium frequencies; 15 days for monthly frequency.
key_terms.suicide_clause: On death due to suicide within 12 months from the date of commencement or latest revival (whichever is later), the nominee/beneficiary is entitled to the Fund Value available on the date of intimation of death; any charges other than FMC recovered after the date of death are added back to the Fund Value.
key_terms.lock_in_note: Five-year lock-in: on surrender or discontinuance before the end of the 5-year lock-in period, only the Discontinuance Value is payable as surrender value at the end of the lock-in period.
key_terms.guaranteed_benefit_note: Guaranteed Death Benefit is 105% of Total Premiums Paid (including top-ups); top-up death benefit is 105% of top-up premium paid. This is the only guaranteed element; vesting/maturity proceeds are market-linked Fund Value.
key_terms.annuity_note: Vesting proceeds must be used to purchase an annuity at the THEN-PREVAILING annuity rate (immediate or deferred); only up to 60% may be commuted; not more than 50% of post-commutation proceeds may be used to buy annuity from another insurer.
key_terms.tax_note: Tax benefits may be applicable on premiums paid and benefits received as per the prevailing tax laws; subject to amendment.

mandatory_disclosures_present: Section 41 — Prohibition of Rebate (mandatory disclosures section present)

claims_marketing_must_support: Benefits differ by variant — Waiver of Premium / future-premium funding applies ONLY to Variant 2 (Assure); any such claim must be variant-qualified.
Any '105% guaranteed' claim is bounded ONLY to the Guaranteed Death Benefit (105% of Total Premiums Paid) — it does not guarantee the vesting corpus or returns.
The vesting/retirement corpus is the market-linked Fund Value, not a guaranteed amount.
Annuity income at vesting is purchased at the THEN-PREVAILING annuity rate — future annuity rates are not fixed or guaranteed today.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT use 'guaranteed pension' / 'assured returns' / 'guaranteed corpus' language — this is a Unit-Linked pension plan and investment risk is borne by the policyholder.
Do NOT use 'bonus' language — the plan is non-participating; Loyalty Addition, Vesting Booster and Return of Allocation Charges are not bonuses.
Do NOT present illustrative market-linked return figures as guaranteed or as upper/lower limits of returns.
Do NOT state or imply a specific guaranteed annuity rate or pension amount — annuity is bought at the prevailing rate at vesting.
Do NOT imply liquidity in the first five years beyond the permitted partial-withdrawal events; funds are subject to a five-year lock-in.
Do NOT describe the commutation limit incorrectly — only up to 60% of the vesting benefit may be commuted.
must_state: Full regulatory descriptor: 'A Unit-Linked, Non-Participating, Individual Pension Plan'
ULIP / market-risk disclosure — investment is subject to capital-market risks borne by the policyholder
Annuity-rate caveat: annuity at vesting is at the then-prevailing rate
Standard disclaimer to read the policy document / benefit illustration for full terms, charges and exclusions
